seasonal_check.extra_time: typically adds about 45 seconds or more (measured +47 s on a 39 km2 test: 4 small composites, +75% on a 61 s run); it is off by default
seasonal_check.what_it_does: flags vegetation-loss polygons whose NDVI also fell in the same windows of earlier years (likely harvest or a seasonal cycle); polygons are never removed

warnings: The two windows are 153 days apart in the seasonal cycle. Vegetation and water change naturally with the season: compare the same time of year in different years to avoid false alarms.
